title: GlowVC: Mel-spectrogram space disentangling model for language-independent text-free voice conversion
abstract: In this paper, we propose GlowVC: a multilingual multi-speaker flow-based model for language-independent text-free voice conversion. Building on Glow-TTS, we consider GlowVC-conditional (speaker-conditioned flow disentangling content and pitch) and GlowVC-explicit (unconditioned flow disentangling content, pitch, and speaker dimensions). GlowVC models greatly outperform the AutoVC baseline in intelligibility and demonstrate that GlowVC-explicit surpasses both GlowVC-conditional and AutoVC in naturalness across seen and unseen languages.
